messages:
Maya (People Ops): @channel Heads-up — SF transit workers have announced a 24hr strike on Wed Apr 20. This will affect BART/MUNI lines during commute windows. We're offering three options for that day: 1) Work remotely (WFH day), 2) Use the satellite coworking space in SOMA (limited capacity), or 3) Book a company shuttle (limited seats). Please pick your preference in this quick form by EOD Mon: https://tinyurl.com/sf-strike-choice

Sam (Facilities): For folks choosing the SOMA coworking option, badge access will be granted for Apr 20 only. Capacity cap: 40 people. We'll enable overflow on Floor 3 if needed. If you need accessible seating, tick the accessibility box on the form.

Elliot (Travel): Reimbursements: shuttle is free. If you end up having to book a rideshare because no shuttle seats are available, we'll reimburse up to $60 for a one-way trip from the city limit. If you incur hotel costs due to overnight travel disruption, submit with receipts and tag "transit-strike" — we'll adjudicate case-by-case.

Jordan: If I WFH, do I still need to mark my calendar as OOO or "remote"?

Maya (People Ops): Just mark your calendar as "Remote - SF Strike" so teams know. No need to mark OOO unless you won't be working.

Priya: Any childcare stipend options? My daycare might be closed for staff shortages on that day.

Elliot (Travel): We don't have a formal daycare stipend for transit strikes, but submit an expense with notes and we'll prioritize approval this cycle. Mention "childcare - transit" in the expense name.

Jordan: Can we get a list of shuttle pickup locations? I live near Embarcadero.

Sam (Facilities): Tentative shuttle plan (subject to demand):
```
07:30 | Embarcadero (Lot 8)
07:50 | SoMa/7th St (corner)
08:10 | Mission/Dolores (stop)
08:30 | Office arrival
```
We'll run one AM and one PM shuttle if demand >20. Reply here with "shuttle: yes" to reserve a seat; please only reserve if you intend to use it.

Nia (Security): Security will staff the lobby and shuttle zone 07:00-09:00 and 17:00-19:00. If you're bringing a guest to the SOMA space, drop their full name in this thread so we can pre-clear them. Badge-swap for SOMA will be handled at the front desk; please show employee ID.

Priya: If I choose SOMA, is lunch provided? I have dietary restrictions (no soy, nut allergy).

Sam (Facilities): We'll offer boxed lunches for those at SOMA. Please add dietary restrictions in the RSVP form — there will be GF/DF/vegan/ nut-free options.

Maya (People Ops): Quick reminders: 
- Finalize choice by Mon EOD (form link above).
- If you need shuttle and are a caregiver or have an accessibility need, tag "priority" on the form.
- Managers: please post team-specific expectations if some folks are required on-site.

Jordan: shuttle: yes

Priya: SOMA (I'll add dietary notes)

Elliot (Travel): calendar-bot created event: "SF Transit Strike — Options & Shuttle" on Apr 20, 07:30-18:30 (labels: people-ops, travel).

Maya (People Ops): Thanks — we'll send a final schedule and shuttle confirmations Tue morning. If anything changes (strike cancelled/extended), we'll update here immediately. Stay safe everyone :heart:
